name: Gruha Lakshmi
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Karnataka
benefit: Monthly financial assistance to the woman head of a family
verification_note: Seed data written from public knowledge; confirm rules, amounts and URLs on the official source before relying on them.
notes: URL and amount must be confirmed on the official portal

rules.text: Woman is the head of the family

documents.name: Aadhaar (identity only — do not enter the number in this app)

steps: Apply on the Seva Sindhu portal or at a local service centre (Seva Sindhu / Janasnehi)
Fill the application with family details and submit it
Note the application number and track status on the portal
Check whether the monthly amount is credited to your bank account
